description: Use this when you need to place parts from a LabWired handoff.json into a KernelCAD assembly. Pass the parsed handoff object using schema labwired-kernelcad-handoff/0.1. The tool validates the handoff and returns an evaluable assembly script with corner-anchored bbox placeholder solids, origin/bbox-face/mounting-hole/pin anchors, endpoint connectivity mates for wires whose two endpoint positions are known, and structured cutout_hints from connector faces. These mates express connectivity intent only; no wire geometry or routing is generated. It does not cut enclosure walls or fetch STEP/GLB assets. position_mm locates the bbox lower corner; bbox.center is derived. Null, estimated, proposed, and other non-exact geometry is reported as warnings and omitted or placed at zero as appropriate.
name: import_handoff
title: Import Design Handoff
